questions.stem: 由於氣候變遷，要確保農民所種的足以養活全國人民並不容易。
questions.answer: Because of climate change, it is not easy to ensure that what farmers grow is sufficient to feed the whole population.
accepted_answers: Due to climate change, it is not easy to make sure that what farmers grow is enough to feed the entire nation.
As a result of climate change, it is hard to ensure that what farmers grow is enough to feed everyone in the country.

patterns: what 名詞子句（農民所種的＝what farmers grow，當 that 子句的主詞）
虛主詞 It ＋形容詞＋不定詞（要確保…並不容易）

questions.stem: 因此，培育耐旱的作物可以提高糧食產量，使農民在乾旱的年份也能有收成。
questions.answer: Therefore, developing crops that can survive droughts can increase food production, allowing farmers to have a harvest even in dry years.
accepted_answers: Therefore, breeding crops that can resist drought can raise food production, making it possible for farmers to get a harvest even in dry years.
Therefore, developing crops that can survive dry weather can increase food production, enabling farmers to harvest crops even in years of drought.

patterns: 句尾分詞片語表結果（…，使農民…）
動名詞片語當主詞（培育耐旱的作物）

1.explanation_zh: 「要確保…並不容易」用虛主詞 It is not easy to ensure that …，比把長長的不定詞放在句首自然。「農民所種的」後面沒有名詞，英文用 what farmers grow（＝the things that farmers grow）當 that 子句的主詞，what 子句視為單數，動詞用 is。「足以…」是 be sufficient／enough to VR；「全國人民」寫 the whole population 或 everyone in the country。
evidence: 要確保農民所種的足以養活全國人民並不容易
1.strategy_zh: 先決定主幹 It is not easy to ensure that＋子句；再把子句的主詞「農民所種的」寫成 what farmers grow。
hints: 切成四段：由於氣候變遷／要確保（…並不容易）／農民所種的／足以養活全國人民
標的詞彙：climate（氣候）、ensure（確保）、grow（種植）、feed（養活）
句型框架：It is not easy to ensure that + what + S + V + is sufficient to VR …

2.explanation_zh: 「培育耐旱的作物」是整個主詞，英文用動名詞片語 Developing crops that can survive droughts，動名詞主詞視為單數。「耐旱的作物」可寫 drought-resistant crops，或用關係子句 crops that can survive droughts。「，使農民…」用句尾分詞 allowing farmers to …（或 making it possible for farmers to …），注意 make 後面不能接 can。「乾旱的年份」是 dry years／years of drought，「有收成」是 have a harvest。
evidence: 培育耐旱的作物可以提高糧食產量
使農民在乾旱的年份也能有收成
2.strategy_zh: 主詞是一個動作（培育作物），先寫成 V-ing 片語；主要動詞 can increase；最後用 allowing … 接結果。
hints: 切成四段：培育耐旱的作物／可以提高糧食產量／使農民／在乾旱的年份也能有收成
標的詞彙：develop（培育）、crop（作物）、drought（乾旱）、production（產量）、harvest（收成）
句型框架：V-ing … + can + VR …, allowing + O + to VR …

common_errors.explanation_zh: 不定詞主詞很長時，英文習慣用虛主詞 It 放前面，把真正的主詞移到後面。

common_errors.right: that what farmers grow is sufficient
common_errors.explanation_zh: which 前面要有先行詞；這裡沒有名詞可修飾，用 what。

traps.explanation_zh: 「氣候變遷」是固定的抽象名詞 climate change，指長期的氣候改變，不是每天的天氣變化 weather changes。

traps.literal_error: it is not easy to ensure that farmers grow is sufficient to feed the whole population
traps.explanation_zh: 中文「農民所種的」省略了中心名詞，直接當主詞；英文要補 what 形成名詞子句，否則 that 子句裡的 is 沒有主詞。

bonus.text: Because of climate change, there is no guarantee that what farmers grow will be sufficient to feed the whole population.
bonus.explanation_zh: 用 there is no guarantee that …（不能保證…）改寫「要確保…並不容易」，搭配同位語 that 子句，語氣更正式。

1.restructuring_zh: 「要確保…並不容易」中文以動詞片語當主詞，英文用虛主詞 It is not easy to ensure that …；「農民所種的」省略了中心名詞，要改成 what 名詞子句 what farmers grow，當 that 子句的主詞。

traps.literal_error: Therefore, develop drought-resistant crops can increase food production.
traps.explanation_zh: 中文直接拿「培育…作物」這個動作當主詞；英文要改成動名詞 Developing …，動詞原形不能當主詞。
「糧食產量」是抽象名詞概念，英文用 food production（或 output）；逐字翻成 producing amount 不是英文的說法。

bonus.text: Therefore, developing drought-resistant crops can boost food production, ensuring that farmers do not go without a harvest even in dry years.
bonus.explanation_zh: 用 ensuring that …（確保…）當結果分詞，並用 go without（沒有…也得過）的否定說法，表達更細膩。

1.translation: Because of climate change, it is not easy to make sure that what farmers grow is enough to feed everyone in the country.
1.explanation_zh: 「要確保…並不容易」用虛主詞 it is not easy to…；「農民所種的」用名詞子句 what farmers grow 當主詞；「足以養活」用 enough to feed；「全國人民」譯成 everyone in the country。

2.translation: Therefore, developing drought-resistant crops can increase food production, allowing farmers to have a harvest even in years of drought.
2.explanation_zh: 動名詞片語 developing drought-resistant crops 當主詞；「提高糧食產量」increase food production；「使農民…也能有收成」用分詞構句 allowing farmers to…；「乾旱的年份」years of drought，「也」用 even 表讓步語氣。

1.translation: Due to climate change, it is not easy to make sure that what farmers grow is enough to feed the whole nation.
1.explanation_zh: 用虛主詞 it is not easy to...；「農民所種的」譯成名詞子句 what farmers grow，「足以養活」用 enough to feed；「確保」可用 ensure 或 make sure，這裡選 make sure that。「由於」介系詞片語接名詞用 Due to。

2.translation: Therefore, cultivating drought-resistant crops can increase food production, so that farmers can still have a harvest even in years of drought.
2.explanation_zh: 「培育」選 cultivate（也可用 breed／develop）；「耐旱的」譯成複合形容詞 drought-resistant；「使農民……也能有收成」用 so that 引導結果／目的子句；「乾旱的年份」譯成 years of drought。

issues_zh: 我的譯文把「培育」譯成 cultivating，第 1 部分 accepted 只有 developing／breeding，target_words 的 develop 只有 breed 一個 alternative；cultivate 是「培育作物」非常標準的譯法，建議補入 alternatives 與 accepted（cultivating drought-resistant crops）。

「使農民……也能有收成」我自然用 so that farmers can still have a harvest …（子句），沒有用 PART 要求的分詞片語 allowing／enabling；第 3 部分 accepted 也沒有 so that 的寫法。中文「使」並不強制引出分詞構句，PART 沒被引出。建議把 so that farmers can … 納入 accepted，或確認出題意圖是只收分詞構句。
